reason: I'm in the middle of a 3-year processor deal and my techs, who are mostly older, barely tolerate the system we have. I'd take the free fee check, but I'm not signing up for a trial that puts two systems on my desk on a Saturday.
objection: My staff are older, they will not learn a new system. Running a second reader and a second screen during the trial doubles the work, and I don't know whether moving card swipes off my processor triggers the exit fee.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it running at a salon like mine, with older techs, that I can call or visit. A written answer that the trial won't trigger my processor's exit fee would also help.
